title: Sign Up Checkbox Causes Error
description: Clicking the 'bring it with you' checkbox during sign up causes an error. The checkbox functionality is broken.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Investigate checkbox click handler in signup form
Fix: Checkbox can be clicked without errors
Checkbox state toggles properly when clicked
Sign up process completes successfully with checkbox checked
Sign up process completes successfully with checkbox unchecked

notes:
Reproduction steps:
1. Navigate to /signup
2. Fill out sign up form
3. Click the 'bring it with you' checkbox
4. Observe error occurs

Likely cause: Event handler issue or state management bug in checkbox component.
